summaryEn: Real-time, interactive video generation and understanding leads the day, headlined by Vidu S1's voice-driven digital characters on consumer GPUs and a wave of event-based, on-device, and multi-target video systems. A second front attacks long-context and efficient LLMs — dynamic bifocal RoPE extension, a survey of linear-attention routing, and a new RL objective breaking the exploration-stability dilemma — alongside benchmarks exposing that half of video evals need no visuals and that proactive, memory-augmented agents materially close long-horizon gaps.
summaryZh: 实时交互式视频生成与理解主导本日：Vidu S1 在消费级 GPU 上实现语音驱动的数字人，并伴随事件相机、端侧与多目标视频系统齐发。第二条战线聚焦长上下文与高效 LLM——动态双焦 RoPE 外推、线性注意力跨层路由综述，以及打破探索-稳定性困境的新 RL 目标——同时基准研究揭示半数视频评测无需视觉即可求解，主动式记忆增强智能体显著缩小长程任务差距。

papers.titleEn: Vidu S1: A Real-Time Interactive Video Generation Model
papers.titleZh: Vidu S1：实时交互式视频生成模型
papers.problemEn: Interactive video generation with voice-controlled digital characters has been too slow and hardware-hungry for real-time, infinite-length output on consumer devices.
papers.problemZh: 语音驱动的数字人交互式视频生成长期受限于速度与算力，难以在消费级设备上实现实时、无限时长的输出。
papers.innovationEn: Vidu S1 pairs TurboDiffusion with TurboServe to deliver high-frame-rate, voice-controlled character animation with infinite-length streaming on consumer GPUs.
papers.innovationZh: Vidu S1 结合 TurboDiffusion 与 TurboServe，在消费级 GPU 上实现高帧率、语音驱动的角色动画与无限时长流式输出。
papers.resultEn: Achieves real-time interactive video generation of digital characters on consumer hardware with infinite-length output and high frame rate.
papers.resultZh: 在消费级硬件上实现数字人实时交互式视频生成，支持无限时长输出与高帧率。

papers.titleEn: Video-Oasis: Rethinking Evaluation of Video Understanding
papers.titleZh: Video-Oasis：重新审视视频理解评测
papers.problemEn: Current video understanding benchmarks conflate linguistic priors with true visual perception, masking real capability gaps in video-LLMs.
papers.problemZh: 现有视频理解基准将语言先验与真实视觉感知混为一谈，掩盖了视频大模型的真实能力差距。
papers.innovationEn: Video-Oasis is a diagnostic suite that isolates visual perception from linguistic reasoning and knowledge priors, exposing how often benchmarks are solvable without the video.
papers.innovationZh: Video-Oasis 提出诊断套件，将视觉感知与语言推理、知识先验解耦，揭示评测在无视频输入下即可求解的频率。
papers.resultEn: Finds that half of existing video benchmarks can be solved without visual input, exposing significant capability gaps in current video understanding models.
papers.resultZh: 发现半数现有视频基准无需视觉输入即可求解，揭示了当前视频理解模型的显著能力差距。

papers.titleEn: Why Can't I Open My Drawer? Mitigating Object-Driven Shortcuts in Zero-Shot Compositional Action Recognition
papers.titleZh: 为什么我打不开抽屉？缓解零样本组合动作识别中的物体驱动捷径
papers.problemEn: Zero-shot compositional action recognition suffers from object-driven shortcuts: models latch onto objects and ignore the verb, breaking verb-object generalization.
papers.problemZh: 零样本组合动作识别存在物体驱动捷径：模型依赖物体而忽略动词，破坏动宾组合泛化。
papers.innovationEn: RCORE introduces co-occurrence prior regularization and temporal order regularization to rebalance verb-object learning asymmetry under sparse compositional supervision.
papers.innovationZh: RCORE 引入共现先验正则化与时序顺序正则化，在稀疏组合监督下重新平衡动宾学习的不对称性。
papers.resultEn: Improves compositional generalization in zero-shot action recognition with new diagnostic metrics quantifying the verb-object asymmetry.
papers.resultZh: 在零样本动作识别中提升组合泛化能力，并提出新的诊断指标量化动宾不对称性。

papers.titleEn: Ideas Have Genomes: Benchmarking Scientific Lineage Reasoning and Lineage-Grounded Idea Generation
papers.titleZh: 想法有基因组：科学谱系推理与谱系驱动想法生成的基准
papers.problemEn: LLM-based scientists lack a structured way to reason about how ideas evolve across papers and to generate new ideas grounded in scientific lineage.
papers.problemZh: 基于 LLM 的科学家缺乏结构化方式来推理想法在论文间的演化，并基于科学谱系生成新想法。
papers.innovationEn: Organizes scientific works as genetic-like Idea Genome objects with GenomeDiff operators, and proposes IG-Bench, IG-Exam, and IG-Arena with a Population-Evolution Score.
papers.innovationZh: 将科学工作组织为类基因的 Idea Genome 对象并定义 GenomeDiff 算子，提出 IG-Bench、IG-Exam、IG-Arena 及种群演化评分。
papers.resultEn: Delivers a benchmark suite evaluating both lineage reasoning and lineage-grounded idea generation, capturing evolutionary dynamics of scientific ideas.
papers.resultZh: 提供评测谱系推理与谱系驱动想法生成的基准套件，刻画科学想法的演化动态。

papers.titleEn: LongE2V: Long-Horizon Event-based Video Reconstruction, Prediction, and Frame Interpolation with Video Diffusion Models
papers.titleZh: LongE2V：基于视频扩散模型的长程事件相机视频重建、预测与插帧
papers.problemEn: Reconstructing long-horizon video from sparse event streams suffers temporal drift and instability when autoregressively unrolled over long sequences.
papers.problemZh: 从稀疏事件流重建长程视频在自回归展开时易出现时序漂移与不稳定。
papers.innovationEn: LongE2V leverages pre-trained video diffusion priors with adaptive context switching, reencoding alignment, cross residual correction, and event voxel density augmentation.
papers.innovationZh: LongE2V 利用预训练视频扩散先验，结合自适应上下文切换、重编码对齐、交叉残差校正与事件体素密度增强。
papers.resultEn: Enables high-quality long-horizon video recovery, prediction, and interpolation from sparse events with strong zero-shot generalization.
papers.resultZh: 从稀疏事件实现高质量长程视频重建、预测与插帧，并具备强零样本泛化能力。

papers.titleEn: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
papers.titleZh: UniClawBench：面向真实世界任务的主动式智能体通用基准
papers.problemEn: Existing agent benchmarks under-test proactivity — exploration, skill usage, and cross-platform coordination — in real-world, closed-loop environments.
papers.problemZh: 现有智能体基准在真实世界闭环环境中对主动性的考察不足——包括探索、技能使用与跨平台协调。
papers.innovationEn: UniClawBench evaluates proactive agents via live Docker containers with executor, supervisor, and user agent roles in a closed-loop, capability-driven assessment.
papers.innovationZh: UniClawBench 通过实时 Docker 容器，以执行者、监督者与用户多角色进行闭环、能力驱动的主动性评测。
papers.resultEn: Provides a capability-driven benchmark for proactive agents in real-world environments with closed-loop evaluation across multiple agent roles.
papers.resultZh: 提供面向真实世界环境的能力驱动型主动智能体基准，支持多角色闭环评测。

papers.titleEn: Enhancing In-context Panoramic Generation via Geometric-aware Pretraining
papers.titleZh: 通过几何感知预训练增强上下文全景图生成
papers.problemEn: In-context panoramic image generation struggles with geometric consistency and global coherence across the 360-degree seam.
papers.problemZh: 上下文全景图生成在 360 度接缝处的几何一致性与全局连贯性上存在困难。
papers.innovationEn: Canvas360 is a two-stage framework combining geometry-aware pretraining (parallel depth generation, velocity circular padding, similarity loss) with task-specific fine-tuning.
papers.innovationZh: Canvas360 提出两阶段框架，结合几何感知预训练（并行深度生成、速度环形填充、相似性损失）与任务特定微调。
papers.resultEn: Improves geometric consistency and global coherence for in-context panoramic generation, introducing the panorama-specific FAED metric.
papers.resultZh: 提升上下文全景生成的几何一致性与全局连贯性，并提出全景专用 FAED 指标。

papers.titleEn: DrugGen 2: A disease-aware language model for enhancing drug discovery
papers.titleZh: DrugGen 2：面向药物发现的疾病感知语言模型
papers.problemEn: Generating small molecules that are both chemically valid and strongly binding for a given disease and target protein remains difficult for generic LLMs.
papers.problemZh: 通用 LLM 难以针对特定疾病与靶蛋白生成既化学有效又具强结合力的小分子。
papers.innovationEn: DrugGen-2 fine-tunes GPT-2 conditioned on disease ontology and target protein sequences, combining supervised learning with GRPO reinforcement learning.
papers.innovationZh: DrugGen-2 以疾病本体与靶蛋白序列为条件微调 GPT-2，结合监督学习与 GRPO 强化学习。
papers.resultEn: Achieves superior molecular diversity and binding affinity over baseline models in disease-conditioned molecule generation.
papers.resultZh: 在疾病条件分子生成中实现优于基线模型的分子多样性与结合亲和力。

papers.titleEn: Jet-Long: Efficient Long-Context Extension with Dynamic Bifocal RoPE
papers.titleZh: Jet-Long：基于动态双焦 RoPE 的高效长上下文扩展
papers.problemEn: Zero-shot long-context extension for LLMs degrades or requires retraining as sequence length varies, hurting RAG and agentic workflows.
papers.problemZh: LLM 的零样本长上下文扩展在序列长度变化时性能下降或需重训练，影响 RAG 与智能体工作流。
papers.innovationEn: Jet-Long dynamically adapts rescaling factors with a bifocal attention mechanism — a RoPE-faithful window plus a long-range window via attention merge and RoPE correction.
papers.innovationZh: Jet-Long 动态调整缩放因子，采用双焦注意力——RoPE 保真窗口与通过注意力合并及 RoPE 校正构建的长程窗口。
papers.resultEn: Maintains high performance across varying sequence lengths with a custom CuTe kernel on H100/Hopper, strong on RULER, HELMET-RAG, and PG-19 perplexity.
papers.resultZh: 在变化的序列长度下保持高性能，H100/Hopper 上配备定制 CuTe 内核，在 RULER、HELMET-RAG、PG-19 困惑度上表现优异。

papers.titleEn: OpenCoF: Learning to Reason Through Video Generation
papers.titleZh: OpenCoF：通过视频生成学习推理
papers.problemEn: Video generation models lack explicit temporal reasoning — they cannot expose or steer the chain of thought linking frames during denoising.
papers.problemZh: 视频生成模型缺乏显式时序推理，无法在去噪过程中暴露或引导连接帧的思维链。
papers.innovationEn: OpenCoF introduces Chain-of-Frame reasoning with visual and textual reasoning tokens, the OpenCoF-17K dataset, and the Wan-CoF model under diverse temporal supervision.
papers.innovationZh: OpenCoF 引入 Chain-of-Frame 推理，结合视觉与文本推理 token、OpenCoF-17K 数据集与 Wan-CoF 模型，提供多样时序监督。
papers.resultEn: Improves temporal reasoning in video generation, validated on video reasoning benchmarks with attention analysis across denoising steps.
papers.resultZh: 提升视频生成的时序推理能力，在视频推理基准上验证并通过去噪步骤的注意力分析。

papers.titleEn: Linear Attention Architectures: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Cross-Layer Routing
papers.titleZh: 线性注意力架构：机制、权衡与跨层路由
papers.problemEn: The proliferation of recurrent linear-attention variants (DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention) lacks a unified comparison of expressivity, memory, and efficiency trade-offs.
papers.problemZh: 递归线性注意力变体（DeltaNet、Gated DeltaNet、Kimi Delta Attention）层出不穷，缺乏对表达力、记忆与效率权衡的统一比较。
papers.innovationEn: Provides a comparative analysis using recurrent-memory notation — memory decay, erase/write control — and proposes Cross-Layer Value Routing (CLVR) over the hidden stream.
papers.innovationZh: 以递归记忆记号（记忆衰减、擦除/写入控制）进行比较分析，并提出基于隐藏流的跨层值路由（CLVR）。
papers.resultEn: Clarifies trade-offs across softmax and linear-attention architectures at varied scales and sequence lengths, introducing CLVR for cross-layer routing.
papers.resultZh: 厘清不同规模与序列长度下 softmax 与线性注意力架构的权衡，并引入 CLVR 实现跨层路由。

papers.titleEn: CineMobile: On-Device Image-to-Video Diffusion for Cinematic Camera Motion Generation
papers.titleZh: CineMobile：面向电影级镜头运动的端侧图生视频扩散
papers.problemEn: Image-to-video diffusion models are too large and slow to run on mobile devices while preserving cinematic camera motion quality.
papers.problemZh: 图生视频扩散模型过大过慢，难以在移动端运行同时保持电影级镜头运动质量。
papers.innovationEn: CineMobile combines distillation-guided pruning, diffusion distillation, and hybrid post-training quantization to compress DiT image-to-video models for mobile.
papers.innovationZh: CineMobile 结合蒸馏引导剪枝、扩散蒸馏与混合训练后量化，将 DiT 图生视频模型压缩至移动端。
papers.resultEn: Achieves significant speedup and parameter efficiency on mobile devices while maintaining visual quality and cinematic motion effects.
papers.resultZh: 在移动端实现显著加速与参数效率，同时保持视觉质量与电影级运动效果。

papers.titleEn: Remember When It Matters: Proactive Memory Agent for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.titleZh: 在该记住时记住：面向长程智能体的主动式记忆代理
papers.problemEn: In long-horizon tasks, decision-relevant state gets buried or pushed out of the context window, causing 'behavioral state decay' where facts stop influencing decisions.
papers.problemZh: 长程任务中决策相关状态被淹没或挤出上下文窗口，导致「行为状态衰减」——事实不再影响决策。
papers.innovationEn: A separate memory agent runs alongside an unmodified action agent, selectively injecting memory-grounded reminders rather than passively exposing the memory bank.
papers.innovationZh: 独立记忆代理与未修改的动作代理并行运行，选择性地注入基于记忆的提醒，而非被动暴露记忆库。
papers.resultEn: Improves pass@1 by +8.3 pp on Terminal-Bench 2.0 and +6.8 pp on τ²-Bench; open-weight Qwen3.5-27B memory policy trained via SFT+GRPO.
papers.resultZh: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 上 pass@1 提升 8.3 个百分点，τ²-Bench 提升 6.8 个百分点；开源 Qwen3.5-27B 记忆策略经 SFT+GRPO 训练。

papers.titleEn: UP: Unbounded Positive Asymmetric Optimization for Breaking the Exploration-Stability Dilemma
papers.titleZh: UP：打破探索-稳定性困境的无界正不对称优化
papers.problemEn: RL for LLMs faces an exploration-stability trade-off: clipping stabilizes training but caps exploration, while aggressive updates destabilize.
papers.problemZh: LLM 的强化学习面临探索-稳定性权衡：裁剪稳定训练但限制探索，激进更新则破坏稳定。
papers.innovationEn: UP is a universal objective using unbounded positive asymmetric optimization with conservative clipping and a stop-gradient operator to expand probability capacity for exploration.
papers.innovationZh: UP 提出通用目标，利用无界正不对称优化、保守裁剪与停梯度算子扩展概率容量以增强探索。
papers.resultEn: Enables stable training with enhanced exploration, applicable to GRPO, DAPO, and GSPO at both token and sequence level.
papers.resultZh: 在保持训练稳定的同时增强探索，适用于 GRPO、DAPO、GSPO，支持 token 级与序列级优化。

papers.titleEn: SAM-MT: Real-Time Interactive Multi-Target Video Segmentation
papers.titleZh: SAM-MT：实时交互式多目标视频分割
papers.problemEn: Extending single-target video object segmentation to multiple targets replicates processing per object, so latency grows unboundedly with target count.
papers.problemZh: 将单目标视频分割扩展至多目标需逐对象复制处理，延迟随目标数无界增长。
papers.innovationEn: SAM-MT builds on SAM2 with explicit parallel target queries, a shared global context, decoupled masked attention, and sparse memory for distinct identities.
papers.innovationZh: SAM-MT 基于 SAM2，采用显式并行目标查询、共享全局上下文、解耦掩码注意力与稀疏记忆保持身份独立。
papers.resultEn: Decouples latency from target count, achieving >36 FPS for 10 targets on par with single-target baselines while retaining SAM2 quality.
papers.resultZh: 将延迟与目标数解耦，10 目标下达 36+ FPS，与单目标基线持平且保持 SAM2 质量。
